verses.2: Therefore, let the wind bring me back to my place, and in the midst of all these troubles, may I be restored to peace.
verses.3: May my ears hear, and may the spirit of my understanding answer me.
verses.4: You know this from me, from me alone. For it is I who place people upon the earth.
verses.5: For the laughter of the wicked comes from afar, and their joy lasts forever.
verses.6: If he rises to the heavens, his head will be brought down to the ground.
verses.7: As a tree that will be cut down forever, its branches will be cut off. They will say, “Ah!”
verses.8: In their confusion, they couldn’t find him; he remained hidden, like a star in the night sky.
verses.9: Look at his actions; do not add anything to them, and do not change their place.
verses.10: Their sons will love the poor, and their hands will be strong.
verses.11: His own bodies were filled with darkness, and he lay on the ground.
verses.12: If there is a disease in his mouth, it will be cured under his control.
verses.13: He will protect her, and he will not leave her. She will be safe in his care.
verses.14: His blood became a source of horror and disgust in his own body.
verses.15: Hail, you who have swallowed up everything; may God take you from among us.
verses.16: The head of the serpent will be bitten by it, and it will kill it.
verses.17: Do not look at the branches of the rivers and streams.
verses.18: It will not be swallowed up, nor will it be destroyed. Its words remain unbroken, and it will not be overcome.
verses.19: Since he ran away, he abandoned the ruins of the house. He didn’t even try to rebuild it.
verses.20: For he did not know that in his own body, at the time of his death, he would not be able to walk anymore.
verses.21: There is no leftover to eat; therefore, its goodness will not be enjoyed.
verses.22: In full vigor, he created everything with his own hands; all those labors were necessary for his creation.
verses.23: May his belly be filled with worms; may he vomit blood, and may he suffer in battle.
verses.24: It will run away from Neshek’s iron; it will pass over the net that has been woven.
verses.25: And he stepped out of Giva. With the coldness of his darkness, demons would walk upon him.
verses.26: All darkness that lies hidden will be consumed by fire. No one will survive in their shelters.
verses.27: The heavens will reveal their secrets, and the earth will be prepared for him.
verses.28: The house will be destroyed on the day of Abo.
verses.29: This is the punishment that a wicked person deserves from God. It’s a fate that befell him because of his evil deeds.
